City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 18, 2015 -
05:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 2/5/15 Joint Special Meeting, 2/11/15 Joint Special Meeting, 2/11/15 Regular Meeting, 2/18/15 Special Meeting, 2/18/15 Regular Meeting, 2/25/15 Joint Special Meeting and the 2/25/15 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
(Updated Page 29) 2015-03-18 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2015-03-18 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Adoption of Ordinance 2015-02 amending Chapter 9.50 of the Encinitas Municipal Code regarding skateboarding, in-line skates, roller skates, toy vehicles, coasters and similar forms of transportation. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Stauffer
Adopt Ordinance 2015-02 entitled, "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California Amending Chapter 9.50 of the Encinitas Municipal Code."
2015-03-18 Item 8C - Ordinance 2015-02 - Skateboards, Skates and Coasters
8D.
Summary vacation of a portion of an abandoned County highway easement at 331 Union Street. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Maher
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015-08 approving the summary vacation of a portion of an abandoned county highway located at 331 Union Street.
2015-03-18 Item 8D - Summary Vacation 331 Union St.
8E.
Second reading and adoption of City Council Ordinance No. 2015-01, titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting amendments to Title 30 of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Cardiff-by-the-Sea, Downtown Encinitas, Encinitas Ranch and North 101 Corridor Specific Plans" to address changes in State law, correct errors and improve existing regulations. CASE NUMBER: 14-089 ZOA/SPA/LCPA; APPLICANT: City of Encinitas; LOCATION: Citywide Contact Person: Associate Planner Winter
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2015-01, titled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, adopting amendments to Title 30 of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Cardiff-by-the-Sea, Downtown Encinitas, Encinitas Ranch and North 101 Corridor Specific Plans".
2015-03-18 Item 8E - Adoption of Ordinance 2015-01 Title 30 Amendments
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
A review of the City of Encinitas and Mizel Family Foundation Community Grant Program. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam
Review the grant program process and the FY2014/15 annual report, and receive recommendations.
2015-03-18 Item 10A - Community Grant Program Report
10B.
Public Hearing to consider funding recommendations for eligible projects under the FY2015-16 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Program. Contact Person: Management Analyst Piano-Jones
1) Authorize funding of recommended projects and activities delineated in Attachment A and the Analysis Section of the Agenda report for incorporation into the draft FY2015-16 Annual Action Plan; and, 2) Continue the public hearing to April 22, 2015 in order to gather and consider public input prior to Council's final approval of FY2015-16 funding and the FY2015-16 Annual Action Plan.
2015-03-18 Item 10B - FY2015-16 CDBG Funding Recommendations
10C.
Presentation of the Let's Move Encinitas! Pedestrian Travel and Safe Routes to School Plan and approval of the plan. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Villa
Receive staff's presentation and approve the Let's Move, Encinitas! Pedestrian Travel and Safe Route to School Plan for implementation and incorporation into the City's future Active Transportation Plan.
2015-03-18 Item 10C - Let's Move Encinitas Ped Plan Approval (Note: May take a minute to open)
10D.
Discussion and authorization to staff regarding the potential collective withdrawal and dissolution of the San Diego Pooled Insurance Program Authority (SANDPIPA). Contact Person: Risk Manager Schwarm
Authorize the Risk Department Manager, as the designated voting SANDPIPA Board Member, to work with all twelve member cities toward a collective withdrawal and dissolution of SANDPIPA.
2015-03-18 Item 10D - SANDPIPA Agreement

16.

17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
